headline: 3 injured as gunmen open fire in Dhaka's Gandaria
summary: A woman and two men were shot during a sudden clash in the Munsirtek area of Swamibagh on Sunday evening.
details: Three people were injured in a shooting incident at Munsirtek in Dhaka's Swamibagh area on Sunday evening.
The injured—Mohammad Siam (22), Alamgir Hossain (32), and Asha Akter (28)—were rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH).
Mohammad Siam, a hotel worker, reported that he was shot in the right shoulder while closing his shop's shutter during a sudden street fight.
Alamgir Hossain, a tea stall owner, was shot in the forehead while inside his shop as gunfire broke out in front of him.
Asha Akter, a homemaker, was caught in the crossfire and sustained a bullet wound to her right thigh while walking along the road.
caption:
A sudden street fight in Dhaka's Swamibagh turned violent, leaving three people with bullet wounds.

Three people were injured in a shooting incident at Munsirtek in Dhaka's Swamibagh area on Sunday evening.

The injured—Mohammad Siam (22), Alamgir Hossain (32), and Asha Akter (28)—were rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH).

Mohammad Siam, a hotel worker, reported that he was shot in the right shoulder while closing his shop's shutter during a sudden street fight.

Alamgir Hossain, a tea stall owner, was shot in the forehead while inside his shop as gunfire broke out in front of him.

Asha Akter, a homemaker, was caught in the crossfire and sustained a bullet wound to her right thigh while walking along the road.

headline_marked: Tk 40 lakh gold robbery: [[JCD and BNP leaders arrested]] in Dhaka
headline: Tk 40 lakh gold robbery: JCD and BNP leaders arrested in Dhaka
summary: Police arrested two political leaders in connection with the theft of 200 grams of gold ornaments near Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
details: Police have arrested a Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) leader and a ward-level BNP leader for the robbery of gold ornaments worth approximately Tk 40 lakh in the Airport Police Station area of Dhaka.
The arrestees are Al-Amin Shanto, 27, secretary of the Airport thana unit of JCD, and Abdur Rauf, 40, president of an organisational ward of Airport thana BNP.
According to the DC of Uttara division, Mirza Mohammad Tareq Baig, 100 grams of gold were recovered from the suspects, while 100 grams remain missing.
The case was filed on August 29 by Mohammad Suman, who claimed that 200 grams of gold sent by his brother from Malaysia for a wedding had been stolen.
Suman and an associate were allegedly surrounded and assaulted by four men near Balaka Bhaban after collecting the gold from the airport.
The suspects allegedly identified themselves as members of the Awami League and Chhatra League and threatened the victims with bombs before taking the ornaments.
Police are currently searching for the other two accused individuals who remain absconding.
caption:
Two political leaders arrested for stealing Tk 40 lakh worth of gold near Dhaka airport.

Police have arrested a Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) leader and a ward-level BNP leader for the robbery of gold ornaments worth approximately Tk 40 lakh in the Airport Police Station area of Dhaka.

The arrestees are Al-Amin Shanto, 27, secretary of the Airport thana unit of JCD, and Abdur Rauf, 40, president of an organisational ward of Airport thana BNP.

According to the DC of Uttara division, Mirza Mohammad Tareq Baig, 100 grams of gold were recovered from the suspects, while 100 grams remain missing.

The case was filed on August 29 by Mohammad Suman, who claimed that 200 grams of gold sent by his brother from Malaysia for a wedding had been stolen.

Suman and an associate were allegedly surrounded and assaulted by four men near Balaka Bhaban after collecting the gold from the airport.

The suspects allegedly identified themselves as members of the Awami League and Chhatra League and threatened the victims with bombs before taking the ornaments.

Police are currently searching for the other two accused individuals who remain absconding.
